subtitle: Somalia's best-known public beach, banned under Al-Shabab occupation until 2011 and bombed at least five times since for the freedoms it represents.
spike_statement: Al-Shabab has bombed Mogadishu's Lido Beach at least five times since 2016, killing roughly 90 people, and each time the crowds return within weeks.

levers.photo_tone: Indian Ocean turning bronze at dusk over a beachfront hotel row still standing after repeated blasts, families and umbrellas back on the sand within weeks of the last one
